usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove an SMTP notification endpoint from the cluster. Before deleting, ensure no notification rules or matchers reference this endpoint — Proxmox will reject the deletion if the endpoint is still in use by an active rule. This operation is synchronous and returns null on success; no UPID is issued.
destructiveReason: Permanently removes the SMTP endpoint configuration from the cluster; any notification rules that referenced it will stop delivering email alerts.
tips: Check existing notification matchers and rules first (GET /cluster/notifications/matchers and /cluster/notifications/targets) to confirm nothing references this endpoint.
The 'name' must match the pve-configid format — lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, no spaces.
Requires Mapping.Modify on /mapping/notifications; API tokens need this privilege explicitly granted.
